title: platform-objects: the Setup Users list has no column that says who holds platform-admin standing, now that the legacy `role` scalar leaves it (#28105 D1 follow-up)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Ruled: 6566734829 · letter C · 2026-11-02T01:16Z
Ruling-ref: 6566734829

Filing gate: ① the follow-up card the director's ruling on #28105 binds (comment 6557746678, letter D1, maintainer 「同意」 on 2026-11-01 at 12:10Z): "a follow-up card is filed at p3". Filed by `domain:server` seat 5, the seat executing #28105. Graded p3 by the ruling.

Reach: every Setup admin scanning the Users list for who is a platform admin, the need #27863 stated.
Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/platform-objects` for the list view; `packages/core` owns the predicate).

## What is true today (read on `origin/main` `d9c4cdc4e`)

- Platform-admin standing is decided by `hasPlatformAdminStanding` (`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:2145`): a verified email in `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`, or, under the `single` tenancy posture, an unscoped `admin_full_access` assignment in `sys_user_permission_set`.
- `sys_user.role` is better-auth's own legacy column and does not say this. Under #28105 D1 it leaves the `all_users` list and the record highlights.

## Wanted

- The Users list gains a column (or an equivalent served mark) derived from real platform-admin standing, read through the same predicate, never a second copy of the rule.
- ⛔ Nothing is written into `sys_user.role`: the #9652 veto (comment 5334874978) stands, and D1 rejected S1 (projecting standing into the scalar).
- Measure first how a derived, non-stored column is served on a platform list view today (a formula field, a served-beside key, or a computed read) and pick the existing mechanism; say which in the PR.

Blocked-by: #28105 (it removes the `role` column this card's column replaces).

Dedupe: searched `platform admin column users list`; only #28105 and #27855. **New.**

Links back: #28105 (ruling 6557746678), #27863, PR #28065.
